title: Great Hangers
text: Great Hangers. I discovered velvet hangers about a year ago. I love that they are thinner and take up less space in the closet. The velvet texture helps keep clothes from slipping off the hangers. I've been gradually replacing my old style plastic hangers with velvet ones. There are 60 hangers in this set so that will probably allow me to finish the task. I love the bright pink color!
